name: Lisbon
tagline: Europe's Sunniest Capital for Early Retirement
description: Lisbon has become the undisputed FIRE capital of Europe, offering the D7 passive income visa, the NHR tax regime with potential zero-tax on foreign income, and a thriving expat community. With 300 days of sunshine, world-class seafood, and living costs a fraction of Western Europe, it delivers first-world infrastructure at developing-world prices.

quickFacts.visa: D7 Passive Income Visa (renewable, path to citizenship in 5 years). NHR tax regime offers 10-year tax benefits on foreign income.
quickFacts.safetyRating: Very Safe — 6th safest country globally (Global Peace Index)
quickFacts.nearestAirport: Lisbon Humberto Delgado Airport (LIS) — 15 min from city center
quickFacts.climate: Mediterranean with mild winters (10-15°C) and warm summers (25-30°C). Over 300 days of sunshine per year.

housing.description: Room in a shared flat, Arroios / Benfica / Marvila

dining.description: Cooking most meals from market produce with tascas a few times a week

healthcare.description: An entry-level private policy from a Portuguese insurer such as Multicare or Medis - the minimum that satisfies the D7 visa's insurance requirement.

entertainment.description: Free miradouro sunsets, neighborhood fado, and Cascais beach trips

1M.lifestyle: A frugal-but-livable Lisbon base — a room in a shared flat in a residential, non-tourist area like Arroios, Benfica, or Marvila, well-connected by metro. Cooking most meals from market produce with tascas a few times a week, moving on the Navegante transit pass, and D7-compliant private cover in place. Comfortable and livable, though dining out and travel are planned around the budget.

housing.description: 1BR of decent size, edge of central

dining.description: Dining out several times a week at good restaurants

healthcare.description: Mid-tier private plan, wider network (Médis Option 2)

entertainment.description: Surf lessons in Ericeira, live music, and cultural memberships

2M.lifestyle: A one-bedroom of decent size in a desirable area such as Príncipe Real, Santos, or the Chiado edge. Dining out several times a week, comprehensive private cover at a hospital like CUF Descobertas, and weekend rental-car trips to Sintra or the coast. Day-to-day life is easy, with little need to think about everyday costs.

dining.description: Regular top-restaurant meals including the occasional Michelin table

healthcare.description: Comprehensive private plan, broad network, faster access (Médis Option 3)

entertainment.description: Tagus sailing, VIP cultural events, and Azores or Madeira getaways

3M.lifestyle: A one-bedroom in a desirable central district — Príncipe Real, Santos, or Chiado — near the city's best cafés and viewpoints. Regular dining at top restaurants including the occasional Michelin table, a broad-network private plan with international coverage, the transit pass with Bolt rides on top and a rental car for weekend trips, and regional flights to the Azores or Madeira. Genuinely affluent living in a city where the budget goes far.

dining.description: Near-daily dining at the city's best tables

healthcare.description: Premium private cover or entry-level international plan

transportation.description: Add a leased/luxury car and private transfers, with a driver for occasions at 10M

entertainment.description: Exclusive golf, charters, and premium cultural experiences

5M.lifestyle: A larger, high-spec apartment at a prime-central address. Near-daily dining at the city's best tables, premium private cover, regular housekeeping, and a leased luxury car for Algarve weekends. High-quality daily life with real comfort, and Lisbon's costs stretch the budget further than in most Western European capitals.

dining.description: Private-chef dining and the finest tables in the city

transportation.description: Add a leased/luxury car and private transfers, with a driver for occasions at 10M

entertainment.description: Art patronage, private retreats, and premium cultural-and-social life

luxuryExtras.description: Interior design, art curation, bespoke travel

10M.lifestyle: A luxury one-to-two-bedroom on Avenida da Liberdade or in historic Lapa with river views. Private-chef dining, top-tier international health cover, a premium car and private transfers on top of transit — with a driver for occasions — full household help, and a generous travel budget. This sits near the ceiling of the premium services Lisbon offers, and everyday money is never a thought.
